title: Black Oil Fluid Model
description: The data content for a black oil fluid model, which is a simplified method for simulating oil and gas reservoirs by treating oil, gas, and water as separate phases with basic properties and empirical relationships.

FluidModelID.description: OSDU Identifier of the associated Fluid Model WPC.

items.title: Frame of Reference Meta Data Item
items.description: A meta data item, which allows the association of named properties or property values to a Unit/Measurement/CRS/Azimuth/Time context.

kind.title: UOM Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, 'Unit' for FrameOfReferenceUOM.

name.title: UOM Unit Symbol
name.description: The unit symbol or name of the unit.

persistableReference.title: UOM Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying the Unit.

unitOfMeasureID.description: SRN to unit of measure reference.

propertyNames.title: UOM Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides Unit context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

kind.title: CRS Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, constant 'CRS' for FrameOfReferenceCRS.

persistableReference.title: CRS Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying the CRS.

propertyNames.title: CRS Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides CRS context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

kind.title: DateTime Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, constant 'DateTime', for FrameOfReferenceDateTime.

name.title: DateTime Name
name.description: The name of the DateTime format and reference.

persistableReference.title: DateTime Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying DateTime reference.

propertyNames.title: DateTime Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides DateTime context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

kind.title: AzimuthReference Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, constant 'AzimuthReference', for FrameOfReferenceAzimuthReference.

name.title: AzimuthReference Name
name.description: The name of the CRS or the symbol/name of the unit.

persistableReference.title: AzimuthReference Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying AzimuthReference.

propertyNames.title: AzimuthReference Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides AzimuthReference context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

OilTable.title: Oil Table
OilTable.description: This is an array of saturated and undersaturated oil properties, such as viscosity and formation volume factor, as a function of pressure and GOR (gas oil ratio) at a constant temperature and for a specified separation process.

items.title: Oil Table
items.description: This object captures the saturated and undersaturated oil properties, such as viscosity and formation volume factor, as a function of pressure and GOR (gas oil ratio) at a constant temperature and for a specified separation process.

BubblePointPressure.title: Bubble Point Pressure
BubblePointPressure.description: This is the bubble point pressure for a specific solution GOR.

SolutionGOR.title: Solution GOR
SolutionGOR.description: This is represented as a ratio depicting the amount of dissolved gas at the corresponding bubble point pressure.

Pressure.title: Pressure
Pressure.description: This is an array of pressure steps defined for this model.

FormationVolumeFactor.title: Formation Volume Factor
FormationVolumeFactor.description: This is an array of oil formation volume factor values corresponding to the pressure array.

Viscosity.title: Viscosity
Viscosity.description: This is an array of oil viscosity values corresponding to the pressure array.

Temperature.title: Temperature
Temperature.description: This is the reference temperature used in generating this model.

SurfaceDensity.title: Surface Density
SurfaceDensity.description: This is the density of the oil component at stock tank conditions. If provided, this supersedes the value at the root model level.

InterpolationExtrapolationMethod.title: Interpolation Extrapolation Method
InterpolationExtrapolationMethod.description: Data interpolation and extrapolation method used by the simulator.

InterpolationExtrapolationMethodID.title: Interpolation Extrapolation Method ID
InterpolationExtrapolationMethodID.description: Data interpolation and extrapolation method used by the simulator.

InterpolationExtrapolationMethodInstruct.title: Interpolation Extrapolation Method Instruction Set
InterpolationExtrapolationMethodInstruct.description: Additional instructions providing additional context on the approach used when applying the interpolation or extapolation method.

Parachor.title: Parachor
Parachor.description: An emprical constant for a liquid (in this case, the oil phase) that relates the surface tension to the molecular volume (reference MacLeod-Sugden equation for surface tension calculation)

CarbonContent.title: Carbon Content
CarbonContent.description: Specifies the number of moles of carbon per mole of the oil phase at surface.
CarbonContent.x-osdu-frame-of-reference: UOM:amount of substance per amount of substance

MolecularWeight.title: Molecular Weight
MolecularWeight.description: Molecular weight of the oil phase

OilUndersaturatedCompressibilitiesTable.title: Oil Undersaturated Compressibilities Table
OilUndersaturatedCompressibilitiesTable.description: This is an array of saturated oil properties, such as viscosity and formation volume factor, as a function of GOR or composition, which are used alongside compressibilities in  calculating undersaturated properties.
